description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Trending DEX liquidity pools with buy/sell pressure data across multiple timeframes (5m, 1h, 6h, 24h). Sourced from GeckoTerminal (free, no key). Supports 100+ networks: eth, base, bsc, arbitrum, polygon_pos, solana, etc. Returns pool name, price, price change %, volume, buy vs sell transaction counts, and a buy_pressure_24h_pct metric (% of transactions that are buys — above 50% = net accumulation, below 50% = net distribution). Useful for spotting early momentum, identifying which on-chain tokens agents are accumulating, and validating signals from price feeds with raw flow data.
